Subject: Cross-team approval rail + security & procurement contacts (post-call)

Hi Sanjay & Priya — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a few requests so we can align internal stakeholders and get procurement/security questions out of the way before the exec review.

Recap (high level):
- Use case: semi-structured clinical notes enrichment for CareOps (batch + streaming ingestion).
- Target SLA: sub-250ms p99 for patient-facing summarization; bulk batch overnight processing for full historical backfill.
- Volume estimate: ~18M tokens/month initial pilot, scale later to ~120M tokens/month.

As discussed, could you help by sharing the following so we can map approvals and speed procurement?
1) A simple org chart or list of decision roles (economic buyer, procurement owner, security/compliance owner, legal reviewer).
2) Procurement contact (email) and any RFx timeline windows (PO process, typical lead time).
3) Security evidence requests: do you require SOC2 Type II, encryption-at-rest proof, or a vendor questionnaire? If you have an existing security contact, please loop them in.
4) Any hard decision criteria (price/latency thresholds, data residency constraints, vendor restrictions).

If easier, a one-page org chart and a procurement contact CSV is perfect — we can draft a short MAP and a pricing band for the procurement review.

Next steps I propose: I’ll share a short mutual action plan and a security artifact list; if you can share the org chart and procurement email by end of week we’ll get the MAP back and schedule a 30-min session with your econ buyer + procurement.

Thanks — really appreciated.

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.ai]

[Attachment: none]

Hi Jasmine — great call yesterday. Forwarding a couple of things to get you started.

Quick answers:
- Economic buyer: Maya Srinivasan, VP Product (maya@meditech.io) — she owns the budget for platform & analytics.
- Procurement: procurement@meditech.io (lead: Oliver Kent, oliver.kent@meditech.io) — typical PO timeline ~3 weeks for ISV contracts after SOW.
- Security contact: Priya Das (cc’d) is our security reviewer for pilots; she’ll want SOC2 evidence and a data flow diagram.
- Decision criteria: reliability (p99 latency), token cost per 1k, and ability to run in our VPC (private deployment) are musts.

I attached a 1-page org chart and a CSV with the procurement points of contact. Also, can you send a short SOW template and a pricing band for the pilot? Maya prefers a concrete MAP up front so legal/procurement can scope resources.

Thanks —
Sanjay

Meditech Health
